issue_title: Let a deploy stage name the environment it targets
issue_body: A workflow-v1 deploy stage cannot say which environment it targets, so every deploy goes to the runner's default cluster. Let a deploy stage name its environment, carry it on the deployment artifact, and refuse a deploy to an environment the repository has not registered.

plan.summary: Add an environment field to workflow-v1 deploy stages, carry it on the deployment artifact, and refuse a deploy to an unregistered environment.

approach.description: In docs/spec/workflow-v1.schema.json, add environment (a non-empty string) to the deploy stage's properties and to its required list, editing the v1 file in place so a v1 spec whose deploy stage omits it is refused at parse, then mirror it with scripts/sync-schemas.
Carry the parsed environment on the deploy stage in backend/internal/spec/parse.go and stamp it on the deployment artifact.
In backend/internal/deployreconciler/reconciler.go, refuse a deploy whose environment is not in the repository's registered environment list, naming the environment, before the runner starts.
Document the field in docs/spec/workflow-v1.md and add parse tests for a present and an empty environment plus a reconciler test for an unregistered one.

verification.test_strategy: Parse tests over v1 fixtures for the environment field, a reconciler test for an unregistered environment, and the schema-sync check in verify.
verification.rollback_plan: Revert the PR and re-run scripts/sync-schemas.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A deploy stage that names an environment records that environment on its deployment artifact.
A deploy to an environment the repository has not registered is refused, naming the environment, before the runner starts.

defect_phrases: and to its required list, editing the v1 file in place
a v1 spec whose deploy stage omits it is refused at parse

catching_examples.note: Step 1 adds environment to the deploy stage's required list in workflow-v1 in place. ADR-046 D6 says new optional fields continue additively within each major line; a required field makes every existing v1 spec with a deploy stage stop validating. Add it as optional (x-intended-required) or carry the requirement in a new major.
Putting environment on the required list is a non-additive change to a coexisting major: under ADR-046 each major is frozen and only optional fields are added within it.
Editing the v1 file in place this way breaks existing v1 specs that ADR-046 keeps validating indefinitely.

non_catching_examples.note: Step 1: the environment field is unjustified.
Step 1 changes the deploy stage; ADR-038 defines the deploy stage's release governance, so confirm the environment is recorded where its deployment artifact expects it.
Step 1 edits docs/spec/workflow-v1.schema.json; cite the record that governs that file in the plan.
ac-unregistered-environment-refused does not say where the registered environment list lives.
The required list change in step 1 has no test for an environment of only whitespace.
